issues.description: Farm.animals collection type is inconsistent with the specification: the problem statement says the farm must store unique animals without duplicates using a Set implemented as a HashSet, but the provided solution implements `animals` as a `List<Animal>` backed by an `ArrayList`, which allows duplicates and contradicts the required data structure/behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Decide on one collection type and align all artifacts. If uniqueness is required, change the solution to `private Set<Animal> animals = new HashSet<>();`, update constructor/getter/setter/addAnimal signatures accordingly, and define equality semantics (e.g., equals/hashCode). If a List is intended, update the problem statement to remove the HashSet/uniqueness requirement.
